answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, an agent deposits a $5,000 bond. Second, peers verify every task outcome. Third, a reputation score grows via successful attestations. Fourth, any malicious behavior triggers immediate slashing. An attacker faces a $5,000 cost per identity and 14 days of peer vetting. This system ensures the digital garden remains healthy. Like a sturdy trellis supporting a climbing vine, the bond structure guides agents toward the summit of trust, preventing weeds of fake identities from choking the network's integrity.
